cookie_policy_log_info_text: This website collects standard internet log information, including your IP address, browser type and language, geolocation, access times and the addresses of the websites you come from. To ensure that our website is well managed and to make navigation easier, we or our service providers may also use cookies (small text files stored in the user's browser) to collect aggregated data. Further information on how we use cookies and other tracking technologies, and on how you can control this data, can be found below.
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies: Cookies - what are they and why do we use them?
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_p1: The information set out here is intended to inform users of this website about the setting, use and management of all cookies collected by Codage d.o.o.
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_p2: Cookies are small text files that are sent to and stored on your computer, smartphone or other internet-enabled device every time you visit a website.
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_p3: Cookies are used to give visitors to this website a better experience by identifying errors that may occur during use and by delivering content tailored to their needs. Cookies also provide anonymous statistical information about how the website is used. Based on the feedback obtained through cookies, Codage can take steps to make the website more efficient and easier for users to access.
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_p4: If you wish, you can restrict, block or delete cookies by changing your browser settings, but this may mean that the website will not work properly.
cookie_policy_what_are_cookies_p5: For more information about cookies and their impact on you and your browsing, visit www.aboutcookies.org.
types_of_cookies: The types of cookies we use
types_of_cookies_p1: We use Google Analytics (GA) to track user interaction. We use this data to establish the number of visitors to our website, to better understand how users find and use our website, and to follow their journey through it.
types_of_cookies_p2: Although GA records data such as your geographical location, device, internet browser and operating system, none of this information personally identifies you to us. GA does not record your computer's IP address. For traffic within the EU, IP address data is used solely to derive geographical location data before being immediately discarded. It is not recorded, accessed or used in any other case. We consider Google to be a third-party processor, and their Privacy Policy is available
cookie_policy_recaptcha_p1: On our contact form we use the Google reCAPTCHA v3 service to protect against spam and abuse. The service assesses in the background whether an interaction was carried out by a human or an automated bot. For this purpose it loads Google scripts, may set cookies, and may collect data about your device and browser (for example your IP address and information about your behaviour on the page).
cookie_policy_recaptcha_p2: Use of the service is subject to Google's
disabling_cookies_p1: Most internet browsers allow you to delete cookies from your computer's hard drive, block all cookies (or only third-party cookies), or warn you before a cookie is stored on your device.
disabling_cookies_p2: Instead of blocking all cookies, you can choose to block only third-party cookies, which will still allow our website to function normally.

privacy_policy_intro_p1: Codage d.o.o. (hereinafter referred to as “we”, “us” and “our”) is an organisation that values privacy. As such, we have a duty of care towards the people whose data is held in our records.
privacy_policy_intro_p2: This Privacy Policy explains how Codage collects, uses, processes or otherwise handles information, including information that personally identifies you (“Personal Information”), and how you can control the collection, correction and/or deletion of such information when using our website. By using this website, you consent to the use of such information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
privacy_policy_intro_p3: Our policy complies with Croatian law as implemented in accordance with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy_policy_intro_p4: Controller of website visitors' information: Codage d.o.o. The company is registered with the Commercial Court in Split (Croatia) under registration number: 060445698, with its registered office at Put gaja 6, 21292 Srinjine, Split, Croatia.
privacy_policy_collect_info_p1: In some cases, we may collect personal information about you for the following purposes:
privacy_policy_collect_info_subtitle_1_p: If you send us information in connection with a job vacancy, we will use that personal information solely in connection with the vacancy you are applying for. In that case, we will ask at a minimum for your name, contact number and email address. You may optionally also provide us with: your area of interest, LinkedIn URL and CV.
We will contact you on the contact number or email address you provide, and further information will be sent by email unless you state otherwise.

However, if you wish, we can keep your application and personal information for up to five years, in case we decide to contact you at a later date should something interesting come up. You can change this by sending an email to kontakt@codage.hr

Accordingly, if we employ you, we will collect information about you and your work from time to time throughout your employment. This information will be used only for purposes directly related to your employment. After your employment ends, we will keep your files for as long as the law requires.
privacy_policy_collect_info_subtitle_2: Contacting us (general enquiries, business, sponsorship, media...)
privacy_policy_collect_info_subtitle_2_p: This website may collect content that you provide, including but not limited to your CV (and all data within it), posts on any blogs, forums, wikis and other social media applications and services that we may provide.

We do not normally request sensitive information (e.g. data about racial or ethnic origin, religious beliefs, criminal record, physical or mental health, or sexual orientation) from visitors, and visitors are prohibited from posting or sending such data.
In general, when you contact us, whether by telephone, through our website or by email, we collect the data you have given us in order to reply with the information you need.

We record your enquiry and our response in order to increase the efficiency of our business. We keep personally identifiable information associated with your message, such as your name and email address, in order to track our communication with you and to provide a high-quality service.

If you choose to contact us via the contact form on our website, the data you provide will be stored on this website and compiled into an email that will be sent to us using the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP). Our SMTP servers are protected by TLS (also known as SSL), which means the email is sent over an encrypted connection using SHA-2, 256-bit cryptography, and is sent by a secure server operated by MailJet.
Information obtained through web forms or directly by email may be retained for as long as necessary, but no longer than five years.
The privacy settings for the social networks on which we maintain our official company profile are described on each social network as follows:
Personal data and sensitive personal data will be stored, processed, used and disclosed in the following ways
Providing our recruitment services to you, whether you are a client, a candidate or a user of our website.
Enabling you to submit your CV, apply for specific jobs or update your work preferences.
Maintaining our business relationship, where you are a user of our website, a client or a candidate.
Providing information about suitable job opportunities to people who register with us, so that we can match your profile with suitable vacancies and help us find the position that suits you best.
Fulfilling contractual obligations towards our clients
privacy_policy_disclosure: Disclosure of information to third parties
privacy_policy_disclosure_p1: Although we do not disclose your personal information to any third party (except as set out in this policy), we sometimes receive data that is indirectly compiled from your personal information from third parties whose services we use.
privacy_policy_disclosure_p2: Personal information may also be disclosed to judicial, regulatory or other government agencies, or to other third parties, in each case in order to comply with legal or regulatory obligations or requirements.
privacy_policy_recaptcha_p1: To protect the contact form against abuse, we use the Google reCAPTCHA v3 service (provided by Google Ireland Limited). As part of this check, certain data may be transmitted to Google, for example your IP address and information about your interaction with the page, which may be processed outside the European Economic Area subject to appropriate safeguards. We use this data solely for the security assessment, not for advertising.
privacy_policy_recaptcha_p2: You can read more about how Google processes data in Google's
privacy_policy_info_access_p1: In accordance with applicable data protection legislation, all website visitors may exercise their rights to access, rectify and erase their personal data, the right to restrict the processing of their personal information, and the right to data portability. You may also, on legitimate grounds, object to the processing of your personal data. You can exercise these rights at any time by sending us proof of identity.
privacy_policy_info_access_p2: Where the processing of your personal data is based on your consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time by contacting us by email at kontakt@codage.hr
privacy_policy_info_access_p3: In accordance with applicable data protection legislation, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy_policy_info_retention_p1: Your personal information will not be retained for longer than is strictly necessary to achieve the purpose set out in this policy and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
privacy_policy_info_retention_p2: In this respect, the information processed is retained solely in order to perform the requested service.
privacy_policy_info_retention_p3: In addition, we are likely to retain your personal information in anonymised form for the purpose of producing statistical studies.
privacy_policy_info_retention_p4: Log information and cookie information are retained for a maximum of five years, unless you choose otherwise.
privacy_policy_child_protection_p1: We understand the importance of protecting children's privacy in an interactive online world. This website is not designed for, or intentionally directed at, children under the age of 16. It is not our policy to intentionally collect or maintain information about anyone under the age of 16. Therefore, if you are under 16, please do not attempt to send us any personal information about yourself.
privacy_policy_info_security_p1: We have reasonable commercial standards of technology in place and implement technical and organisational security measures to protect all information that visitors provide through this website against unauthorised access to, disclosure, alteration or destruction of the information provided. We regularly update and test our security technology and apply technology that meets the highest security standards. To maintain security, we grant access to personal data only to authorised employees, provide ongoing GDPR training to all employees, and take appropriate measures to enforce employee accountability for privacy.
privacy_policy_changes_p1: This Privacy Policy may change from time to time in line with legislation or industry developments. We will not notify our clients or website users of these changes explicitly. Instead, we recommend that you check this page periodically for any changes to the policy. When we make changes to this Policy, we will amend the revision date at the top of this page.
privacy_policy_changes_p2: Our privacy policy is drafted to comply with the laws of every country or jurisdiction in which we intend to do business. If you believe it does not meet the law of your jurisdiction, we would like to hear from you.
privacy_policy_suggestion_p1: Codage will always do everything in our power to make your experience with us outstanding! Even so, if you are not satisfied with this privacy policy, feel free to contact us by email at kontakt@codage.hr. about_lead: Codage is a software studio in Split that approaches every project with full commitment and care.
about_story_p1: Codage brings together engineers with years of experience building web and mobile applications for local and international clients - from Croatian recruitment platforms to American EdTech products.
about_story_p2: We believe a good application grows out of understanding the business it supports. That's why questions come before code, and a conversation comes before a quote. We work transparently, in short cycles, and we stay with the project after launch.
about_story_p3: Our mission is simple: technology that works for your business, not the other way round.
about_value_1_desc: No jargon, no hidden costs. You always know where the project stands.
about_value_2_desc: Clean, documented and tested code - because you'll live with it for years.
about_value_3_desc: Launch is the beginning, not the end. We maintain and we upgrade.
about_value_4_desc: We adopt new technology when it brings real value - not because it's fashionable.

svc_web_lead: We build web applications that solve a real business problem - from internal platforms to products for your customers. Design, development and maintenance in one place.
svc_web_intro_title: An app that fits how you work
svc_web_intro_p1: Off-the-shelf software rarely matches how your team actually works. A custom web application is built around your processes, users and data - so the tool adapts to your business, not the other way round.
svc_web_intro_p2: Every project starts with a conversation, not a quote. Together we define what the app needs to achieve, propose the structure and design before the first line of code, then build in short cycles with regular demos. You always know where the project stands.
svc_web_item_1_desc: Systems for clients, partners or staff - with sign-in, user roles and clear workflows.
svc_web_item_2_desc: From the first version to a product that grows: subscriptions, user accounts and solid architecture.
svc_web_item_3_desc: Apps that replace spreadsheets and manual work, saving your team hours every week.
svc_web_item_4_desc: We connect your systems - payments, CRM, ERP or third-party services - into one whole.
svc_web_tags: React · Next.js · Laravel · Node.js · Spring Boot · Java · Scala · AWS
svc_web_faq_1_q: How much does a custom web app cost?
svc_web_faq_1_a: It depends on scope and complexity - the number of features, integrations and user roles. The first call and the project estimate are free, and afterwards you get a clear quote with no hidden costs.
svc_web_faq_2_a: It depends on scope. We agree the timeline in the estimate and build in short cycles, so you see and test working parts of the app throughout the project - not just at the end.
svc_web_faq_3_a: We stay with you. We take care of monitoring, support and upgrades, so the app stays secure, fast and aligned with your business.
svc_web_faq_4_q: Can you take over an existing app?
svc_web_faq_4_a: Yes. We start with a technical review of the code, architecture and security, then propose a plan - from small fixes to gradual modernisation.
svc_mobile_lead: We build native and cross-platform mobile apps that people enjoy using - fast, intuitive and equally good on iOS and Android.
svc_mobile_intro_p1: A mobile app is often a customer's first touchpoint with your business, so it has to work flawlessly. We help you choose the right approach: native development when performance and device features matter most, or React Native when you want one codebase for iOS and Android.
svc_mobile_intro_p2: We connect the app to the web system or backend you already have, or build it alongside the app. The same team handles design, development and maintenance - no hand-offs.
svc_mobile_item_1_desc: Products for your clients - from bookings and orders to user accounts.
svc_mobile_item_2_desc: Tools for field work, records and internal processes - available on the go.
svc_mobile_item_3_title: Mobile version of an existing system
svc_mobile_item_3_desc: We bring your web platform to mobile, sharing the same backend and data.
svc_mobile_item_4_desc: One codebase for iOS and Android - faster development and simpler maintenance.
svc_mobile_faq_1_a: A native app is written separately for each platform and delivers the best performance. A cross-platform (React Native) app uses one codebase for both, so development is faster and maintenance simpler. We recommend an approach once we understand your needs.
svc_mobile_faq_2_q: Which platforms do you build for?
svc_mobile_faq_2_a: iOS and Android - separately or from one codebase, depending on the project.
svc_mobile_faq_3_q: How much does a mobile app cost?
svc_mobile_faq_3_a: It depends on scope, the number of platforms and the systems the app connects to. The first call and the estimate are free, and afterwards you get a clear quote.
svc_mobile_faq_4_q: Do you maintain the app after release?
svc_mobile_faq_4_a: Yes. We monitor the app, keep it up to date with new iOS and Android versions and develop new features.
svc_design_title_2: Before the first line of code.
svc_design_lead: We define digital goals and turn them into interfaces that make sense at first glance - with technical advice that saves time and money.
svc_design_intro_p1: The most expensive software mistakes happen before development - when the wrong thing gets built. So we first understand your business and users, then propose a solution: structure, flows and design you can try out before development begins.
svc_design_intro_p2: You can also take design and consulting as a standalone service. If we move on to development, the same team carries on - so nothing gets lost in translation.
svc_design_item_1_desc: Interfaces that are clear, consistent and pleasant to use - on the web and on mobile.
svc_design_item_2_desc: A clickable prototype to test your idea with users before development.
svc_design_item_3_desc: A review of existing code, architecture, security and performance, with concrete recommendations.
svc_design_item_4_desc: Together we set the goals, priorities and the scope of a first version that makes sense.
svc_design_tags: UI/UX · Prototypes · Technical audit · Product definition
svc_design_faq_1_a: Understanding your users and goals, the app's structure and flows, wireframes, visual design and a clickable prototype. The result is a design ready for development.
svc_design_faq_2_q: Can I get design only, without development?
svc_design_faq_2_a: Yes - design and consulting are available as a standalone service. If we move on to development later, the same team continues with no hand-offs.
svc_design_faq_3_a: A review of an existing application: code quality, architecture, security and performance. You get a clear list of issues and a prioritised plan to fix them.
svc_design_faq_4_q: When does it make sense to start with design?
svc_design_faq_4_a: Before development. A prototype surfaces ambiguities while they're still cheap to fix - and gives everyone a shared picture of what's being built.
